interpretation.stress: two-strut area, Kt and Euler columns do not replace 3D contact FEA, bolt preload, bearing loads or fatigue

interpretation.physicsnemo: deferred until correlated crank-angle FEA and physical fatigue data define grouped train, holdout and OOD sets
interpretation.simready: deferred until cap, bolts, bearings, crankpin, piston pin, cylinder and paired-rod assembly interfaces are measured
